summary: A TopoQuest map record places a Young Lookout Tower in Johnston County, NC, at 219 ft; no source found gives its build date, staffing or condition.

evidence.supports: TopoQuest lists a Young Lookout Tower in Johnston County at 219 ft
evidence.quote: Young Lookout Tower is a tower located in Johnston County, NC

evidence.supports: TopoQuest gives the Young tower an elevation of 219 ft
evidence.quote: and at an elevation of 219 ft MSL.

evidence.supports: the tower appears on the USGS 1:24K map Dunn, NC
evidence.quote: It can be seen on the USGS 1:24K topographic map Dunn, NC

evidence.supports: CCC constructed numerous towers in the mountains in the 1930s
evidence.quote: constructed numerous towers in the mountains.

evidence.supports: towers typically manned during the fire season, October through May
evidence.quote: Towers were typically manned during the fire season

evidence.supports: WRAL says Johnston County also has several fire towers still standing, unnamed
evidence.quote: Johnston County also have several fire towers still standing.

evidence.quote: Lookout towers can be dangerous, and many are not routinely maintained.

notes_for_editor: Only a TopoQuest map-feature entry names this site. The WRAL article is about a Wake County tower and mentions Johnston County in passing without naming the Young tower; its date is not in my copy. Not checked: NHLR/FFLOS (no cached entry for Young), NC Forest Service Johnston unit records (a contact page appeared in search but was not read), and county library records. The tnlandforms NC list has it as NCT206, coordinates only.
